units.function: Builds portable unique Agent/project slugs and projects the current sidebar order from local entity IDs into those slugs.
units.dependencyDirection: UI helper depends on complete shared Agent/Project DTOs plus shared URL-key functions. It emits a shared portability presentation type and should remain outside domain responsibility logic.
units.keyDataModels: Map<local opaque ID, portable slug> and CompanyPortabilitySidebarOrder containing ordered slug arrays.
units.lifecycle: Sort entities by display name; derive base slugs; allocate numeric collision suffixes; map ordered entity lists; silently drop unresolved IDs; omit an empty sidebar.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 1/1 test on 2026-08-19. It verifies duplicate names, numeric suffix allocation and requested ordering, but not equal-name tie stability, locale differences, stale/foreign entries, duplicate ordered entries, Unicode/case normalization or permutation invariance.
units.designRationale: Preserve user navigation order in a human-readable bundle without exporting database IDs.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS also needs portable presentation preferences, but organizational/reporting/responsibility order must remain a separate authoritative projection keyed by stable opaque identities.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the ID-to-portable-key projection in the independent Web adapter. Add deterministic locale-independent tie-breakers, explicit stale/duplicate diagnostics and a versioned presentation-preferences namespace; never use sidebar order as an org-chart or responsibility contract.
units.responsibilityConflict: Display order contains no accountable-human meaning and silently drops unresolved entities. Treating it as hierarchy would erase reporting and responsibility semantics.
securityFindings: Equal display names compare as zero; stable sort then assigns suffixes by incoming array order, so portable slugs are not invariant under source ordering.
localeCompare can vary by runtime locale and is unsuitable as the sole canonical ordering rule.
Unknown ordered IDs and duplicates are silently dropped/preserved without diagnostics, weakening reviewed-package fidelity.
The helper accepts full Agent/Project objects although it only needs ID/name, increasing UI coupling and accidental data exposure.
